'''Imperial CompLink''' was an organization in the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] that used software that was secretly installed on [[Computer/Legends|computers]] throughout the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to monitor electronic communications. The spyware would transmit information packets to orbiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] transmitters that would forward the information to CompLink Bureau for study by the [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]]. They worked closely with the [[Sector Plexus/Legends|Sector Plexus]].
